card.line: The Sheep Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by priests in Nehemiah's day, and it was near the pool of Bethesda where Jesus healed a man.

moments.title: Priests start the work
moments.text: Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests began rebuilding at the Sheep Gate. They dedicated it and installed its doors.

moments.title: Goldsmiths and merchants repair
moments.text: The goldsmiths and merchants made repairs on the wall between the upper room above the corner and the Sheep Gate.

moments.title: Thanksgiving walk on the wall
moments.text: On the day of thanksgiving, a choir and Nehemiah with half the people walked along the top of the wall as far as the Sheep Gate. Then they stopped at the Gate of the Guard.

moments.title: Jesus at the pool nearby
moments.text: A pool called Bethesda was near the Sheep Gate, and many sick people lay there. Jesus told a man who had been sick for thirty-eight years to get up, pick up his mat, and walk.
